title: Heavy Hoodie
summary: A 450gsm loopback hoodie that holds its shape through a winter.
description:
Loopback cotton at 450gsm, which is roughly twice the weight of a supermarket hoodie and about a third heavier than most of what is sold as premium. The hood is two-panel and lined, so it stands up instead of collapsing at the neck, and the cuffs are ribbed deep enough to stay put.

It is warm enough to be the outer layer well into November, and heavy enough that it takes a day to dry. Both of those are the same fact.
